summary_en: EBARA Foods will acquire up to 240,000 shares (2.46% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 600 million yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 9, 2026 to April 30, 2027, to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency under its medium-term management plan.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, EBARA Foods' board of directors authorized the acquisition of up to 240,000 treasury shares, representing 2.46% of the 9,748,501 outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock held as of October 31, 2026), for a maximum expenditure of 600 million yen. The shares will be purchased through market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from November 9, 2026 through April 30, 2027.

The company stated the acquisition is intended to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency in line with its medium-term management plan, thereby improving market valuation and realizing enhanced corporate value.
